## Problem or use case

What problem are you trying to solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like to see (e.g. arm64 SAR app, smaller binary, extra codec, documentation).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about (different layer, custom build, env vars, etc.).

## Lambda constraints

If relevant, note:

- Target runtime(s) (`nodejs22.x`, `python3.13`, `provided.al2023`, …)
- Architecture (`x86_64` / `arm64`)
- Approximate layer size or cold-start requirements

## Additional context

Links, benchmarks, or examples from other projects help us evaluate scope.
